comparison.objective: Place two potted plants on risers at specified rim depths; not commission an impact absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Pot handling and depth placement versus hex-key alignment, precision rotational adjustment, and torque-controlled locking.
comparison.success_condition: Each inner pot rim 10–20 mm below the planter rim versus two safe impact cycles within stroke and stability limits.
comparison.reason: Different measured physical outcome and manipulation ability. The record lacks fuller scoring, spill/damage rules, and separate specs.
